architectureVerification.method: file(1) run directly against both the installer and the embedded application binary in this build environment

releaseCandidateStatement: This is the Phase 3.5 SOFTWARE RELEASE CANDIDATE for Windows x64 (Operator UX redesign). It is a real, verifiable build artifact - not a placeholder, not a simulation, not a fabrication. Its UX status is HOLD pending physical hardware validation - see docs/phase-3-5-operator-ux.md.
physicalHardwareStatement: Physical hardware qualification has NOT been performed in the build environment. This installer has not been installed, launched, or tested on any real Windows machine, including the target HP EliteBook 830 G6. No real microphone, no real Whisper transcription, no real second display/projector, and no real operator workflow has been exercised against this artifact. Xvfb, simulated audio, virtual displays, automated tests, and cross-compilation success are Environment A/B evidence only and are never substituted for Environment C (real hardware) evidence anywhere in this project's documentation. See pilot-evidence/3.5/windows-ux/windows-ux-checklist.json for the full HOLD breakdown of every timing/usability task.
githubReleaseStatus: NOT CONFIGURED - no .github/workflows directory exists in this repository, and no GitHub Release has been created for this artifact. This installer is available only via this repository's working tree (release/windows/), not via GitHub Releases or any CI/CD pipeline.
obtainingWithoutDeveloperTooling: The file at release/windows/Church Intelligence Platform_0.1.0_x64-setup.exe can be copied/transferred directly (e.g. via a git clone of this repository, a direct file download, or a USB drive) to the target Windows machine and run there. Running the installer on Windows requires none of: Claude Code, Rust, Cargo, Node.js, npm, or the CIP source tree - only the .exe file itself.
